redteam: UPLOAD RED TEAM: CURIOSITY GAP + MOVIE TITLE

Judge the title + thumbnail as ONE unit on a phone. (1) Does the pair OPEN a curiosity gap a stranger feels in 1 second, and does the film really PAY it off? (2) Does the title sound like a real MOVIE title (would it sit on a cinema marquee), or like a YouTube explainer / sermon title? Compare the platform titles to the plain 'THE SECOND FIRE'. (3) Fact-check every claim and quote against the film description (KJV exact, nothing the film does not show, no overclaim). (4) Global audience: words that fail for English-as-second-language readers. (5) Anything off-brand: clickbait, fear, pressure, AI wording beyond one line.
